source.name: Al Gharafa SC on X (@ALGHARAFACLUB): 2026-27 kit launch post
source.quote: الطـقـم الجـديد لموسم 2026-2027 هوية جديدة وطموح لا يتغير #الغرافة | @QIIBOFFICIAL
source.note: The club's 2026-27 home kit launch post (Arabic: 'The new kit for the 2026-2027 season - a new identity, unchanged ambition') tags @QIIBOFFICIAL. QIIB's own 6 Jan 2026 press release (qiib.com.qa/Press/Details/538) names it the club's official sponsor for 2025-26 and 2026-27, and Footy Headlines (14 Sep 2026) reports the QIIB sponsor badge sits centrally across the chest of the 2026-27 away shirt of the same set. footballkitarchive.com's home-kit page (blocked for scripts, 403) also lists the kit.

source.name: Footy Headlines: Al Gharafa 26-27 Away Kit Released
source.quote: Made by Adidas, the new alternate shirt arrives shortly after the club rolled out its primary home look.
source.note: Kit maker. adidas made the club's 2026-27 set, including the yellow home shirt launched 19 Aug 2026 (footballkitarchive.com's home-kit page says 'by adidas' but blocks scripts, 403).

summary: adidas 2026/27 home kit (bright yellow, launched 19 Aug 2026 on the club's social channels). QIIB is the front-of-shirt sponsor: the club's launch post tags QIIB, QIIB's press release of 6 Jan 2026 names it official sponsor for 2025-26 and 2026-27, and Footy Headlines reports the QIIB badge across the chest of the away shirt of the same set. A club match photo from the 11 Sep 2026 league game shows no sponsor on the back or the shorts. Sleeves and any further placements were not verifiable from sources that scripts can open, so the list is not confirmed complete.
